title: Elucidating the mycochemistry and anticancer efficacy of F5 fraction of ethanolic extract of Daldinia eschscholtzii.
authors: Bera, Tanmay; Ghosh, Madhuparna; Ghosh, Swapan Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真菌提取物F5的化学成分及其抗癌活性，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子与凋亡蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Fungi, or mushrooms, are a source of bioactive compounds that have valuable health effects. The column chromatography of ethanolic extract of Daldinia eschscholtzii (DEE) was performed, 10 fractions were collected, and out of them the F5 fraction demonstrated the greatest antioxidant activity by DPPH (1,1 diphenyl-2-picrylhydrazyl) with an EC(50) of 0.94 +/- 0.05a mg/mL. Mycochemistry analysis by liquid chromatography mass spectrum (LC-MS) showed that F5 was a mixture of four compounds, like myricetin, tricin, eudesmin, and (-)-curcumol. Cytotoxicity assay exhibited anti-proliferation activity with IC(50) values of 125.66 +/- 6.34, 96.22 +/- 1.92, and 76.91 +/- 2.05 microg/mL of F5 against A549 lung cancer cell line at 24, 48, and 72 h, respectively. The mechanism of anticancer effect of F5 (DEE) on the cancer cell line (A549) included the induction of apoptosis, reduction of mitochondrial potentiality, and change of gene expression levels of TCASPASE 3, TCASPASE 9, TP53, and TBCL2 of the cell line. The qPCR study showed that TCASPASE 3, 9, TBAX, and TP53 were up-regulated significantly, whereas TBCL2 was down-regulated significantly after the treatment with F5 (50 and 150 microg/mL) for 24 h. It had an anti-migration activity, which was justified by downregulation of TMMP 2 & 9, and TVEGF genes. The physicochemical, pharmacokinetic, and medicinal properties of all four compounds in F5 were screened by three web predictors (SwissADME, pkCSM, and AdmetSAR), and among them, curcumol, tricin, and eudesmin compounds fulfilled all the criteria of different rules or filters (Lipinski's rules, Ghose filter, Veber filter, Egan filter, and Muegge filter) for drug development. Molecular docking studies of the compounds like tricin, curcumol, and eudesmin with receptor proteins like Caspase 3, p53, and BCL2 revealed that tricin had the highest binding energy towards Caspase 3 and p53, allowing upregulation of these genes, while eudesmin showed the highest binding energy (-7.6 kcal/mol) with BCL2, suggesting inactivation of BCL2. In conclusion, F5 of DEE had both anticancer and anti-metastasis properties.
abstract_zh: 真菌（Fungi），或称蘑菇（mushrooms），是含有具有宝贵健康效应的生物活性化合物的来源。对Daldinia eschscholtzii乙醇提取物（DEE）进行了柱色谱分离，收集到10个馏分，其中F5馏分通过DPPH（1,1-二苯基-2-苦基肼）法显示出最强的抗氧化活性，其EC(50)为0.94 ± 0.05a mg/mL。通过液相色谱质谱联用（LC-MS）进行的真菌化学分析表明，F5是四种化合物的混合物，包括杨梅素（myricetin）、三叶豆蔻素（tricin）、桉脂素（eudesmin）和(-)-姜黄醇（(-)-curcumol）。细胞毒性试验显示，F5对A549肺癌细胞系在24、48和72小时的抗增殖活性IC(50)值分别为125.66 ± 6.34、96.22 ± 1.92和76.91 ± 2.05 μg/mL。F5（DEE）对癌细胞系（A549）的抗癌作用机制包括诱导凋亡、降低线粒体膜电位，以及改变细胞系中TCASPASE 3、TCASPASE 9、TP53和TBCL2基因的表达水平。qPCR研究表明，经F5（50和150 μg/mL）处理24小时后，TCASPASE 3、9、TBAX和TP53显著上调，而TBCL2显著下调。此外，F5具有抗迁移活性，这通过下调TMMP 2和9以及TVEGF基因得到证实。通过三个网络预测工具（SwissADME、pkCSM和AdmetSAR）筛选了F5中所有四种化合物的物理化学、药代动力学和药用性质，其中姜黄醇、三叶豆蔻素和桉脂素化合物满足了药物开发的不同规则或过滤器（Lipinski规则、Ghose过滤器、Veber过滤器、Egan过滤器和Muegge过滤器）的所有标准。对三叶豆蔻素、姜黄醇和桉脂素等化合物与受体蛋白如Caspase 3、p53和BCL2的分子对接研究表明，三叶豆蔻素对Caspase 3和p53具有最高的结合能，从而促进这些基因的上调，而桉脂素与BCL2显示出最高的结合能（-7.6 kcal/mol），表明BCL2的失活。总之，DEE的F5具有抗癌和抗转移特性。
